claims.claim: Database registration is required only where the database's primary purpose is collecting personal data to provide to others as a business (data brokers) and it holds data on more than 10,000 / 10,000 individuals, or where the controller is a public body.
claims.raw_snippet: Under the PPL, a database must be registered if one of the following conditions is met: (a) its primary purpose is to collect personal data for the purpose of providing it to others as a business practice or for compensation, including direct mailing services, and the database contains personal data about more than 10,000 individuals; or (b) the controller of the database is a public body (excluding databases of personal data about employees only). In addition, the PPL stipulates a duty to notify the Registrar if the database contains data of special sensitivity about more than 100,000 data subjects.

claims.claim: On a severe security incident the controller must immediately notify the PPA and report the measures taken; the statute says "immediately", not a fixed 72-hour clock.
claims.raw_snippet: Under the Data Security Regulations, in the event of a “severe security incident” (see definition above), the controller must immediately notify the PPA and report the measures taken following the incident.
